arguments.value: Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS desktop became very slow after an apt update/upgrade that also pulled in Ubuntu Pro updates. The user’s high-end PC shows normal memory availability, but top shows a node-related process chain using heavy CPU and browser usage also spikes CPU. The node software has not been updated in about a year, and the user suspects the recent system update/upgrade caused the slowdown.
